# Decisions: writeback-collisions

- 2026-08-06T09:48:53.627Z — chose **Return colliding parallel write-backs from sofar_end_session itself — field omitted when none — computed against the CALLER's session as the reference interval, not the fold's max(ended) winner.** over Locking/leasing the record so a second writer waits; a daemon-pushed SSE notification; or leaving overlappingWritebacks read-side only. because The append is a single O_APPEND write — there is no in-flight window to wait on, and a lease held by a killed agent would deadlock against the Stop hook that blocks exit on a missing write-back. The real defect is that a collision only reaches the NEXT SessionStart, where a fresh agent with no context inherits two next-actions and must guess how they relate; telling the writer at write time reaches an agent that still holds the context to reconcile. Caller-as-reference rather than max(ended) because same-millisecond ties make the winner ambiguous (state.sessions order decides it), and "differs from what I just wrote" is the question the caller actually has.
